mod10 player-state defense reliability r.description: Out-of-sample Spearman-Brown split-half reliability of player ridge coefficients after removing unpenalised team-season offense and defense means from play EPA; alpha chosen on S1 and S3; S2 2020-23 scored; 66 looks (2 designs x 11 alphas x 3 splits); mean OOS across S1,S2,S3 offense about .05 defense about -.11 per-season design
